floors.reason: seed release 2b (the Save seed flow for several plantings): once this ships, prod holds jars with two or more parent rows in seed_lot_parent_planting and jars filed under a household mix variety. Code below v4.170.0 writes inventory_items.source_plant_id alone and cannot see link rows, so it would show and rewrite such a jar as a one-parent jar. Undo release 2b by switching SEED_MULTI_PARENT off (the flag-off build is green as it stands; rehearsal: npm run test:flag-off:seed) BEFORE any undo of release 2a (v4.171.0).

Put-Up B′ schema and writers (v5-pantry-001, v5-batchbuilder-001, v5-recipes-001): once prod holds pantry items, pantry lines, recipes or recipe-linked batches, older code over that data misreads it — v4.164.0 has no route for /api/pantry or /api/recipes, drops pantry lines from What went in and the planting reads, ignores kitchen_batch.recipe_id and the recipe discard basis, and its put-up Remove hard-ignores the jar_was_used / jar_in_batch refusals. Forward-fix only (05-release-train §4).

put-up + ferment schema and writers (v5-putupmake-001, v5-fermentpath-001): older code over this data refuses nothing it should — the legacy PUT has no delta_at refusal and silently overwrites counts that ferment draws moved, getBatch returns taken-out lines, a hard DELETE of a drawn line 23503s on pantry_use, cached 4.164.0 bundles' PATCH /api/preservation/:id and POST /api/pantry/uses hit no route, and after 0p a 1a date edit raises 23514. Forward-fix only.

plant-reduction event tokens renamed (failed -> reduction_lost, given_away -> reduction_given_away): once prod writes or backfills the new tokens, older code does not treat those rows as reductions, so deleting one would not restore its planting's count and the edit guard would let it be re-typed with its counters applied

page-scroll manager: history.scrollRestoration is 'manual' per history entry and only a bundle that knows SCROLL_MANAGER_ENABLED writes 'auto' back, so an older bundle leaves open sessions losing their place on Back until the app is closed

daily-plan schedule: garden-daily-plan-hourly is live and the nightly, intraday-am and intraday-pm rules are retired; deploy-lambda.yml before v4.135.0 re-creates the nightly rule (v4.134.0) or all three (v4.129.0 and earlier) and never deletes the hourly one, so the plan would run on two schedules
